Your information & privacy

When you choose Send, your message, recent conversation and relevant profile details go to OpenAI, the AI provider. On the Plans page, Send also shares the plans you are viewing. Browsing plans makes no AI call. This can include birthday timing, coverage dates, doctors, medicines and pharmacy. Daylight holds recent conversation only for this visit. Saving your profile stores the reported details you choose. Saving is a separate choice.

Saving is optional, for this browser, for 7 days from session creation. Anyone sharing this browser may reopen saved reports. Raw messages, conversation history and unsent drafts are not saved.

Save my reported information in this browser
Also save sensitive details, such as birthday timing, work status, doctors and prescriptions
Apply privacy choices
Scope and service details

Plan cards are five unvalidated 2027 Collier County samples. Recommendations, eligibility, prices, exact doctor/drug fit and enrollment remain independently held. This advisor variant has a $5/UTC-day AI cap within the shared usage ledger. No automatic retries. Production vendor/retention review remains separate.
